probes.name: P-AC5a
probes.subject: tests/services/engine/scaffolder/test_golden_e2e.py
probes.note: AC-5's own claim. Drop the three DB-backed types from the exemption and the donor's core set regains them, while the scaffolder still cannot emit them — so the two-sided set equality reddens. This is what makes 'the oracle stays green BECAUSE of the exemption' a measured statement rather than a description.

probes.note: The tripwire AC-5 requires be RETAINED: an exemption naming an object the donor no longer has is dead weight hiding real drift. It asserts before the set equality, so this mutation reddens it and leaves the other assertion untouched — one probe, one claim.
